# Can I Use Agents?

> A community-maintained compatibility table for AI coding agent features, modeled after caniuse.com. Tracks hooks, MCP, tools, instructions, and memory support across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode.

This site compares feature support across AI coding agents with version-level granularity. Each feature page shows a time-aligned matrix of support across agents, similar to how caniuse.com compares browser support for web standards. Data is stored as JSON and open for community contributions.

## Agents Tracked

- Claude Code (Anthropic): 451 versions from 0.2.31 (Mar 2025) to 2.1.311 (Oct 2026). Covers CLI, IDE extensions, desktop app and web: one agent core and settings. Surface-only features are noted on the feature.
- Codex (OpenAI): 130 versions from 0.2.0 (Jul 2025) to 0.164.0 (Oct 2026). Covers CLI, IDE extension and desktop app: one agent core and config (config.toml, hooks, MCP, AGENTS.md), and the same session logs. Surface-only features are noted on the feature.
- Cursor (Anysphere): 16 versions from 0.45 (Jan 2025) to 3.27 (Oct 2026). Covers Editor and the Cursor CLI: same modes, rules (.cursor/rules, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) and MCP config, per Cursor's CLI docs. Hooks are documented for the editor; the CLI docs don't say whether it runs them.
- GitHub Copilot (GitHub): 120 versions from 0.0.374 (Jan 2026) to 1.0.103 (Oct 2026). Covers Copilot CLI, the agent in VS Code and the GitHub Copilot app: one harness and hook format, per VS Code's hooks docs. Versions follow the Copilot CLI release line; older rows reflect the CLI, from before VS Code shared the harness.
- OpenCode (Anomaly): 21 versions from 0.1.30 (Jun 2025) to 1.19.4 (Oct 2026). Tracked from v0.1.30 (June 2025), when OpenCode was rewritten in TypeScript. Releases 0.0.x were an earlier Go program in the same repository and aren't compared here.

## Hooks & Lifecycle: 10 features

- [Session lifecycle management](/features/hook-session-lifecycle): Hooks for session start and end — initialize environment, load context, clean up resources, or log session activity
- [Generic tool use hooks](/features/hook-tool-use): Pre and post hooks around any tool execution — inspect, modify, block, or log tool calls
- [Subagent lifecycle](/features/hook-subagent-lifecycle): Hooks for when subagents are spawned and when they complete — observe delegation, aggregate results, enforce policies
- [Control shell commands](/features/hook-shell-control): Dedicated hooks for intercepting shell/terminal command execution — block dangerous commands, audit, or inject env vars
- [Control file access](/features/hook-file-access): Dedicated hooks for file read and write operations — enforce access policies, trigger linting, or audit file changes
- [Validate prompts before submission](/features/hook-prompt-validation): Intercept user prompts before they reach the model — block, rewrite, redact, annotate, or inject context
- [Control MCP tool use](/features/hook-mcp-control): Dedicated hooks for MCP server tool invocations — audit, restrict, or modify MCP tool calls independently from built-in tools
- [Observe compaction window](/features/hook-compaction): Hooks that fire before and after context window compaction — preserve critical state, log what gets summarized, or block compaction
- [Agent complete (stop)](/features/hook-agent-stop): Hook that fires when the agent finishes a turn — implement quality gates, force continuation, or trigger follow-up workflows
- [Agent response tracking](/features/hook-response-tracking): Observe and react to the agent's responses — log output, track thinking, or trigger side effects after each message

## Instructions: 6 features

- [Project-level instructions](/features/project-instructions): Repo-specific guidance files checked into version control (e.g. CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, copilot-instructions.md)
- [User-level instructions](/features/user-instructions): Global personal preferences that apply across all projects for the current user
- [Org/managed instructions](/features/org-instructions): Organization-wide instructions enforced via managed policy or team admin settings
- [Path-scoped rules](/features/path-scoped-rules): Instructions that only apply when the agent works with files matching a glob pattern
- [Instruction file imports](/features/instruction-imports): Instruction files can reference or import other files to compose guidance from multiple sources
- [AGENTS.md compatibility](/features/agents-md-compat): The agent reads the cross-agent AGENTS.md format used by multiple coding tools

## Model Context Protocol: 12 features

- [stdio transport](/features/mcp-stdio): Connect to MCP servers via local processes using stdin/stdout
- [SSE transport](/features/mcp-sse): Connect to MCP servers via Server-Sent Events over HTTP
- [Streamable HTTP transport](/features/mcp-streamable-http): Connect to MCP servers via the newer streamable HTTP transport
- [Tool discovery & execution](/features/mcp-tools): Discover and invoke tools exposed by MCP servers
- [Resource support](/features/mcp-resources): Read structured data and context exposed by MCP servers as resources
- [Prompt template support](/features/mcp-prompts): Use templated messages and workflows provided by MCP servers
- [Sampling](/features/mcp-sampling): Allow MCP servers to request LLM completions through the client
- [Roots support](/features/mcp-roots): Expose filesystem or URI boundaries to MCP servers
- [Elicitation](/features/mcp-elicitation): Allow MCP servers to request additional input from the user mid-operation
- [OAuth authentication](/features/mcp-oauth): OAuth 2.0 authentication for connecting to remote MCP servers
- [Project-level MCP config](/features/mcp-config-project): Configure MCP servers per-project, shareable via version control
- [User-level MCP config](/features/mcp-config-user): Configure MCP servers globally for the current user across all projects

## Memory: 3 features

- [Persistent auto memory](/features/auto-memory): The agent automatically saves notes and learnings across sessions without manual effort
- [Conversation resume](/features/conversation-resume): Resume a past conversation with its full context intact
- [Context compaction](/features/context-compaction): Gracefully handles long conversations by summarizing or compacting context when approaching window limits

## Built-in Tools: 16 features

- [File read](/features/file-read): Read file contents from the local filesystem
- [File edit / write](/features/file-edit): Create, modify, and overwrite files
- [Notebook editing](/features/notebook-edit): Read and edit Jupyter notebook (.ipynb) cells
- [Code search](/features/code-search): Search file contents by pattern, regex, or filename glob
- [Shell execution](/features/shell-execution): Execute shell commands in the user's environment
- [Background monitor](/features/background-monitor): Run a process in the background and react to its output (tail logs, poll status)
- [Scheduled tasks](/features/scheduled-tasks): Schedule recurring or one-shot prompts within a session (cron-like)
- [Web search](/features/web-search): Search the web for information
- [Web fetch](/features/web-fetch): Fetch and read the contents of a URL
- [Image input](/features/image-input): Read and understand images and screenshots (multimodal input)
- [Image generation](/features/image-generation): Generate images from text descriptions
- [Browser control](/features/browser-control): Programmatic browser interaction: take screenshots, navigate pages, click elements
- [LSP integration](/features/lsp-integration): Language server features: go-to-definition, find references, type errors, symbol search
- [Semantic search](/features/semantic-search): Search codebase by meaning using embeddings or indexing, not just exact matches
- [Subagent spawning](/features/subagent-spawning): Spawn sub-agents with their own context window to handle tasks in parallel
- [Task management](/features/task-management): Track work progress with task lists and checklists within a session

## Data

- [agents.json](/data/agents.json): Version metadata with release dates and era positions for all tracked agents
- [Feature definitions](/data/features/): JSON files defining all tracked features by category
- [Agent data](/data/agents/): Per-agent JSON files with version-by-version support codes (y/n/a/u/p/d)

## Optional

- [Index page](/): Homepage with category index, feature search, and browseable feature list
- [Feature index](/features/): Alphabetical listing of all tracked features
